description.value:
Rather than dissipate damaging energy, the white mage can redirect some of it back to its source. When an enhancing spell the white mage casts prevents damage (with damage reduction or energy resistance), if the attacking creature is within 30 feet of the protected creature, the foe takes 1d6 points of damage (of the same element or damage type that was prevented) for every 10 points of damage prevented.

Asterisk talent: only one such talent's effect may be applied to an individual spell; decision made before casting.

system.source: Final Fantasy d20 - White Mage (Mage Talents)
